# VertexNormal

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Surfaces](Blitz3D-Surfaces)

</div>


```blitzbasic
VertexNormal:Void surface:Int32, index:Int32, nx:Float32, ny:Float32, nz:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | In | Int32 | required | Surface handle. |
| `index` | In | Int32 | required | Index of the vertex, from 0. |
| `nx` | In | Float32 | required | X part of the normal. |
| `ny` | In | Float32 | required | Y part of the normal. |
| `nz` | In | Float32 | required | Z part of the normal. |

## Description

Sets the normal of a vertex: the direction it faces, which decides how light hits it. The normal should have a length of 1. Set it yourself for hard control over shading, for example to make a flat quad look rounded. [UpdateNormals](UpdateNormals) overwrites all normals of a mesh.
